en.title: Investor Meeting Schedule
en.description:
Each investor is available to meet only within the closed interval [firstDay[i], lastDay[i]]; at most one meeting can be scheduled per day. Find the maximum number of meetings that can be scheduled.

The closed intervals and the daily limit in the statement are explicit; the original text lacks constraints, so this site adds upper bounds on dates and counts.

Source: https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/weride#9-meetup-schedule (fixed statement fingerprint d0ca0bff74708ee0e5b708b2ef4c1f63edc77848111b539ce7e4cdb61d8e2988). The input/output protocol and bounds added by this site are as described in the statement and are not claimed to be rules of the original site.
en.input: The first line contains n (0≤n≤100000); the second line contains n firstDay values; the third line contains n lastDay values. Dates are 1..10^9, and firstDay[i]≤lastDay[i].
en.output: Output the maximum number of meetings.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: Add investors to the candidates by available start day, and each day choose the candidate who ends earliest; if there are no candidates right now, jump to the next start day.
